dates.event: Last Date to Submit Online Application and Pay Fee

howToApply: Visit the Board’s official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in and click on the ‘Apply Online’ link.
New candidates must register by clicking ‘Registration’ and filling in their details to generate a User ID (Email ID) and Password.
Login using the registered Email ID and Password.
Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and other required details accurately.
Upload a passport-size photograph (or capture a live photo via camera) and a scanned copy of your signature.
Click ‘Save Draft’ or ‘Next’ to proceed.
Click ‘Attach Annexure’ and upload scanned copies of 10th class certificate, educational qualification certificates, and other mandatory documents in PDF format.
Click ‘Save Documents’ after uploading all documents.
Click ‘Make Payment’ and pay the application fee online.
After successful payment, click ‘Submit’ to complete the application process.
Take a printout of the submitted Application Form and keep it for future reference.
Note: Once submitted, no changes/corrections will be allowed in the application form under any circumstances.

shortInfo: Punjab Remote Sensing Centre has announced notification for Lab Attendant, Clerk posts. Required qualification: BCA, 10TH, Diploma, B.Sc, Any Graduate. Last date to apply: 05-10-26.
howToApply: Download the prescribed application form from the PRSC website: https://prsc.punjab.gov.in

If fee is deposited online, mention the Receipt/UTR/Acknowledgment Number in the application form and attach proof of fee deposited.

title: DLSA Sangrur Recruitment 2026 – Para Legal Volunteer Posts
shortInfo: DLSA Sangrur has announced notification for Para Legal Volunteer posts. Required qualification: Other. Last date to apply: 05-10-26.
howToApply: Obtain the prescribed proforma (application form) for Para Legal Volunteer.

Fill in all required details including name, father/mother’s name, date of birth, category, residential address, correspondence address, educational qualifications, work area, experience, preferred work location (District/Sub-Division), mobile number, and email ID.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents (category certificate, address proof, educational qualification certificates, experience certificate if any).
Affix a self-attested photograph at the designated place on the form.
Sign the declaration stating no civil or criminal case is pending and that you are not an active political enthusiast of any political party.
Submit the completed application form along with all attachments to the office of District Legal Services Authority, Samjhauta Sadan, Sangrur before 4:00 PM on 05/10/2026.
